subject: history
concept: Understanding the feudal system as a way medieval society organized land and loyalty
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student arranges role cards (king, lord, knight, peasant) into a simple pyramid showing the feudal structure
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a feudal role to its basic responsibilities
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, how land and loyalty were connected in the feudal system

misconception_flags: places feudal roles in the wrong hierarchy order

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
